facts.claim: Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (Costa Rica), 'Sistema de Declaración de Matrimonio en Línea' (translated from Spanish): notaries (personas notarias) celebrate marriages and must declare them to the Registro Civil through the TSE's mandatory online declaration system, which replaced the earlier 'Matrimonio Digital' system. (Read live by the orchestrator, 17 November 2026.)

Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (Costa Rica), 'Sistema de Declaración de Matrimonio en Línea' (translated from Spanish): automatic immediate registration applies only when both spouses are Costa Rican by birth; when either spouse is a foreigner, the notary must upload an image of that spouse's identity document so the identity can be verified and the registration process can continue. (Read live by the orchestrator, 17 November 2026.)

Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (Costa Rica), 'Sistema de Declaración de Matrimonio en Línea' (translated from Spanish): the online declaration does not change or exempt notaries from the requirements of the Family Code (Código de Familia) for celebrating a marriage, and a notary must not celebrate marriages while suspended or barred by the Dirección Nacional de Notariado. (Read live by the orchestrator, 17 November 2026.)
